title: Add pin and hermetic-check defaults; widen reader budget (retry dy62)
summary: Retry of job 20261030-060852-dy62, which was never verified. Root cause: defaults.toml is silent on version-pin policy and on checks depending on ambient tools, so the reader asked the user in jobs 20261016-005805-p806 and 20261025-183644-t67q. The fix adds two defaults, raises the reader budget to fit them, and adds tests on the real defaults file and rendered reader prompt.

defaults_applied.how: Test asserts the rendered reader prompt carries the pin stance.
Fix in defaults.toml, where the policy gap originates.
Tests enforce the entries exist in the reader prompt.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: the reader role (and the user who otherwise gets asked) should settle pin and ambient-tool policy from defaults without a question.

Code survey: read crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs (reader frame, BudgetSet::Reader budget) and crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs line 1625 (reader budget line 'of 2000 tokens used'); crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs parses defaults.toml and renders the reader block. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are not touched; the property is measured by a test on the real defaults.toml and the real rendered prompt.

Job 20261030-060852-dy62 candidate is kept: all seven changed files (defaults.toml, crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs, crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs, docs/decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/system-facts.md) are deliverables; it had no findings and was never verified, so the retry re-does it and gets verified.
Reader budget was measured at 2163 tokens by the earlier producer with the new entries (estimate); budget raised from 2000 to 2200 in both lib.rs and run_pin_tests.rs.
Consumers of defaults.toml: crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs and the prompt composition in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs.
Entries put the stance in the first sentence because the reader sees only that sentence.

acceptance_criteria.text: defaults.toml has a new [[default]] entry (id version-pins) whose first sentence says pins are exact, never auto-floated, and bumped only by the person running Athena through one explicit command that sets the pin to the installed version; scoped to code, config and build.

defaults.toml has a new [[default]] entry (id hermetic-checks) saying a check never depends on inherited environment or ambient tools, the runner passes every path a check needs explicitly, and any preferred-versus-fallback tool choice is recorded in the check output.
The reader budget in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs is raised (to about 2200) and the matching line at crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs ~1625 is updated to the same figure.

docs/decisions.md gets a new appended decision with a Provenance bullet naming the root cause, jobs 20261016-005805-p806 and 20261025-183644-t67q, and the budget change; no existing entry is edited. CHANGELOG.md has an entry naming the root cause (defaults silent on pin and ambient-tool policy). docs/system-facts.md is updated only where it states the reader budget or defaults count.
athena.toml, workflows, xtask, claude.rs, wiring.rs, live.rs, README.md, checks.rs, gh.rs, config.rs and run.rs are unchanged per git diff; defaults.toml is the only governance file changed.

Run `cargo test`: a new test in crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs parses the real defaults.toml, asserts both new ids exist with key phrases (exact, never auto-floated, ambient), and asserts the rendered reader prompt contains both; it fails on the base tree and passes with the change.
Run `cargo test`: the reader prompt-budget test in run_pin_tests.rs and the athena-context budget tests pass with the raised budget.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy` (warnings denied) and confirm both pass; recorded checks on the final tree also count.

out_of_scope: Patch-tolerant version acceptance in claude.rs, xtask claude_accepts, wiring.rs, live.rs, README.md (job 20261016-005805-p806 candidate): dropped.
An xtask repin command that rewrites athena.toml: the default names the command; building it is a separate job.
cargo-nextest adoption, athena.toml [tools] pins, ci.yml, checks.rs, gh.rs, config.rs, run.rs (job 20261025-183644-t67q): separate job.
Editing athena.toml, workflows or other prompt files.
urgent_reason: Prevents repeated reader questions and rejected jobs for the same missing-policy cause, cutting redo retries.
hard_reason: Changes the defaults and prompt budget that the reading step uses to decide whether to ask, which alters the run pipeline's reader behavior.
